QUOTE: Runtime (function pointers).** Leave `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` undefined. Call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`... **Compile time (macros).** Define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`... the runtime setter is compiled out (`platform.c:20-22`). The macros take precedence if both styles are configured.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair, and it says the runtime setter is compiled out when the macros are defined, which makes the two mutually exclusive.
